open_points.subject: A06 list-order ownership
open_points.text: `store` “Owns ... A06: the order of every list read from the store”, while `projects`, `customers`, `artifact_pointers`, `agent_sessions`, and `audit_log` each also say they own their corresponding A06 list order.
open_points.question: Does `store` own and guarantee the ordering of stored-record queries, or does each record module own and enforce the order of its lists?
options: `store` owns every A06 ordering rule and record modules only consume ordered results
Each record module owns its A06 ordering rule and `store` only provides unordered reads or ordering primitives
Split ownership explicitly by naming which ordering facts belong to `store` and which belong to each record module
open_points.default_guess: `store` owns query ordering; record modules own only the list operations and consume the ordered results.

open_points.subject: confirmation-id minting
open_points.text: A14 rule 5 says “A confirmation id is minted only for an accepted, confirmed action that changes state,” but `operations` says it “mints the confirmation id before handing the action on ... and keeps it only when the action is accepted and changed state,” so refused and no-op confirmed actions also cause an id to be minted and discarded.
open_points.question: Is a confirmation id minted only after acceptance and a state change are known, or may `operations` mint one speculatively before the action and discard it on refusal or no-op?
options: Mint only after the action is known to be accepted and state-changing
Mint before invoking the action and discard the id unless the action qualifies
Reserve random material before the action but define that reservation as something other than minting a confirmation id
open_points.default_guess: Mint speculatively inside the transaction and persist it only for an accepted state change, with the audit-erasure exception.
